text:
lina-accounts: Heads up — ACME EU (DE) is pushing back, they need the invoice in EUR with their PO# on the header and a VAT breakdown that shows local VAT ID. Our issued invoice was USD and the card charge failed (declined by their bank). Can we reissue and fix rounding mismatch?

maria-support: FYI customer opened a ticket: TKT-2298. They attached the PO. card failure code: card_declined_insufficient_funds. They expect corrected invoice before approving payment again.

samir-billing: Thanks. Do we have the original invoice lines? I see total on our USD invoice $12,345.67 but converted EUR shows €11,111.11 and accounting flagged a 0.02 EUR rounding delta vs their system.

lina-accounts: Attached snippet from accounting export:
```
description,amount_usd,rate,amount_eur
prod usage,12345.67,0.9000,11111.103
VAT,0.00,0.0000,0.000
TOTAL,12345.67,0.9000,11111.103
```
They want totals rounded to cents (11111.10) and PO on header.

alex-revenue: Also note: German customers usually require the invoice to list the PO number and VAT ID on the header for accounts-payable automation. If we send a USD invoice they reject the automation.

maria-support: Customer says their AP system won't accept invoices with a 0.02 EUR mismatch even though that's just rounding from FX. They want the reissued invoice to match their PDF exactly.

samir-billing: Action plan: 1) Reissue invoice in EUR with rate and rounding to 2 decimals (bankers rounding?) 2) Put PO# and VAT ID in header 3) Mark invoice as reissued and attach note referencing TKT-2298.

ops-bot: [invoice-service] Reissue job queued: job_id=inv-77231. Estimated completion ~2m.

maria-support: Quick repro for engineering/troubleshooting — our billing export used raw multiplication then truncated to 3 decimals before summing. Example curl to fetch invoice JSON:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBOARD" https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/INV-2025-1133
# returns line_items with unit_amount_usd and exchange_rate
```
We should ensure formatting rules create 2-decimal EUR totals.

samir-billing: I requeued a manual reissue with rounding=2, rounding_mode=HALF_EVEN, included PO 4321-DE and VAT ID DE123456789. Will attach the original payment attempt notes so support can retry card.

maria-support: Customer will reattempt card charge after they receive corrected EUR invoice. They flagged their bank's decline as likely temporary.

alex-revenue: Can finance confirm whether reissuing in EUR will cause any recognition issues for booked revenue? If we convert earlier we may need a FX adjustment entry. Tagging @lina-accounts.

lina-accounts: We'll create an FX adjustment memo and route to accounting. Small rounding diffs handled via rounding account; no revenue re-recognition expected for this amount.

maria-support: Communicated to customer: "We're reissuing a EUR invoice with your PO and VAT ID and corrected rounding. Expect email in ~5 minutes. Once received, please retry the payment and reply to ticket TKT-2298." :thumbsup:

samir-billing: Reissue succeeded. inv-77231 -> INV-2025-1133-R1. PDF includes PO: 4321-DE, VAT: DE123456789, totals: €11,111.10. Attached to ticket.

maria-support: Customer confirmed receipt and said their AP accepted the PDF mapping. Planning to retry card.

ops-bot: [payments] Retry scheduled: retry_id=pay-9902 for charge CHG-8844 in 1h.

maria-support: Will monitor. Closing loop here but keeping ticket open until payment clears and receipt uploaded.

alex-revenue: Follow-up: product/finance should add a configurable invoice locale option per customer (currency, rounding mode, PO header fields). Filing feature request: FEAT-901.

lina-accounts: Thanks all. Great quick turnaround.
